title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling. After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.
items.summary_zh: MoTIF-X以图结构化学基元为共同锚点，联合分子图、SMILES和3D构象进行多模态分子表征学习，并用于分子性质预测和药物-靶点相互作用预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时覆盖九个OpenADMET ExpansionRx端点、药物-靶点相互作用和外部冷启动数据集，并以消融和实验活性变化支持基元级解释；但性能优势仍取决于所用基准和预训练分布。
items.abstract_zh: 分子表征学习是计算机辅助药物发现的核心。分子图、SMILES字符串和3D构象提供互补的结构信息，但许多多模态方法分别编码这些视图，仅在较晚阶段进行对齐，从而限制了细粒度的跨模态交互和亚结构级可解释性。为解决这些局限，我们提出MoTIF-X，这是一种以基元为中心的框架，使用以图为基础的化学基元作为多模态整合与解释的共享锚点。其第一阶段预训练通过在原子、基元和分子尺度之间进行分层对比学习来学习基元表征。第二阶段通过多模态掩码标记建模，利用SMILES和扭转角标记对这些表征进行上下文化。在含有多个构象的类药分子上预训练后，MoTIF-X在全部九个OpenADMET ExpansionRx端点上取得最低的平均绝对误差，并在所评估方法中获得最佳总体性能。多重检验校正后的显著性分析支持其在绝大多数端点-基线比较中的优势。消融研究支持基元标记上下文化、多模态整合和两阶段预训练的互补贡献。除分子性质外，该框架还扩展到药物-靶点相互作用预测，在所评估基准上取得最佳平均分类性能，并在无需额外微调的情况下泛化到外部药物冷启动数据集。其以基元为中心的设计还实现了亚结构级解释：更高的基元归因分数与实验测得的更大活性变化相关。总体而言，这些结果支持MoTIF-X作为一种可迁移且可解释的分子建模框架。
items.author_line: Linqing Mo, Jiayu Zhou, Bin Chen

items.title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
items.abstract_or_text: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
items.summary_zh: TMCS将组合化学问题形式化为由专门化代理、外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆和结构化反思组成的闭环工作流，连接分子生成、理解、编辑、描述和优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对需要定量约束、候选验证和失败后修订的化学任务提供统一框架，并在多个任务和开源、闭源基础模型上报告一致提升；但摘要未给出任务规模、基线细节或实验化学验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在计算化学中前景广阔，但严格的组合化学问题仍然困难，因为它们需要定量约束下的分子修改、候选验证，以及失败尝试后的系统性修订。现有的工具增强型化学代理展现了有用的规划和工具使用能力，但很少提供面向性质的分子优化与工作流级组合的统一循环。为弥合这一差距，我们提出用于组合化学问题求解的工具扎根多代理推理（Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving，TMCS），一种将化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强型工作流的分步多代理框架。在任务层面，专门化代理利用外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆和结构化反思，迭代改进解答。在工作流层面，TMCS将生成、理解、编辑、描述和优化串联成闭环流程。在多个化学任务上的评估表明，TMCS在开源和闭源基础模型上都能持续增强化学推理，并取得最先进性能。
items.author_line: Shengqin Wang, Jie Jin, Yu Cheng, Yihang Chen, Weilin Luo, Yuan Xie, Zhizhong Zhang

items.title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
items.abstract_or_text: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.
items.summary_zh: Mirror-Score为异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物提出校准的仅推理评分，并用31个晶体复合物和文献亲和力检验ProteinMPNN及Boltz-2评分在D-肽设计中的排序能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确显示原始ProteinMPNN负对数似然并非可靠亲和力排序指标，并提出按靶标家族校准的替代方案；但病毒进入家族仅含3种独立化学型，结果仍是方向性证据而非统计学验证的预测器。
items.abstract_zh: D-肽兼具蛋白酶抗性和高靶标特异性，但D-肽结合剂的计算设计仍不成熟。Mirror-Peptidizer提出了一个计算机内镜像筛选流程，使用靶标反射、骨架生成和ProteinMPNN序列设计，但其原始ProteinMPNN负对数似然（NLL）排序尚未根据实测亲和力进行验证，并且测试的9个MDM2设计中只有4个表现出可检测的结合。我们提出Mirror-Score，一种针对异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准型、仅推理评分框架，并建立了一个公开基准，包含来自四个靶标家族的31个晶体复合物，其中18个具有文献验证的亲和力。原始ProteinMPNN NLL不是有效的亲和力排序指标：其合并后的Spearman亲和力相关系数为0.19，而且在MDM2/CHIP（+0.62）和gp41（−0.70）之间相关性发生反转。因此，我们评估了Boltz-2镜像空间协同折叠置信度。对于完整的病毒进入家族（7个结构，代表3条肽），界面预测局部距离差异检验（pLDDT）在结构层面的留一法Spearman rho = 0.90（p = 0.006），并正确地按亲和力排序了3条肽，而NLL失败了（结构层面rho = 0.18）。由于其中仅代表3种独立化学型，这一结果说明了方向一致性，而不是经过统计学验证的预测器。当前样本量下，跨家族校准无法迁移，支持将家族匹配校准作为实际部署模式。我们还为来自铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）的耐药性靶标LasR和LecB规定了一个前瞻性设计方案，包括镜像结构、配体衍生的热点图、适用于扩散模型的输入以及Mirror-Score排序。代码、基准数据、结构和分析脚本均已公开发布，网址为https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score。

items.title: A scalable recombinant pipeline for disulphide-stapled peptides
items.abstract_or_text: Constrained macrocyclic peptides can engage protein surfaces that resist both small molecules and biologics but producing them at library scale still depends on chemical synthesis and macrocyclisation workflows that are slow, specialised and hard to parallelise. We describe a recombinant pipeline for disulphide-stapled cyclic peptides, compatible with 96 well plates, that lowers this barrier. Peptide-encoding sequences are introduced by extension PCR and in vivo assembly (IVA) cloning at about 2 per variant, expressed as small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) fusions secreted to the oxidising periplasm, where the intramolecular disulphide forms spontaneously, and purified by immobilised metal-affinity chromatography (IMAC) with analytical size-exclusion chromatography (SEC). The route from a list of designs to characterised material takes about one week, much of it unattended. Applied to a 60-design library across nine protein targets, the pipeline gave purified products for all 60 designs, at a median total soluble yield of approximately 135 micrograms per 6 mL culture (range 9 to 261) that varied by target. Ellman's assay across 38 designs showed disulphide-formation failure to be sequence-driven and uncorrelated with yield, detecting a failure mode invisible to chromatography. Surface plasmon resonance confirmed target binding and showed that the recombinant SUMO fusion constructs retained affinities comparable to their corresponding peptide-only forms. Complementary to general-purpose recombinant platforms, the pipeline enables higher-throughput disulphide macrocycle screening and is amenable to partially or fully automated workflows.
items.summary_zh: 研究建立了适用于96孔板的重组表达流程，用于并行制备二硫键稳定的环肽，并在9个蛋白靶标的60个设计上验证产率、二硫键形成和结合活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将受限大环肽的制备从慢速、难并行的化学合成推进到一周左右的半自动化流程，并用Ellman检测和表面等离子体共振揭示序列依赖的失败模式；不过产率随靶标变化，且摘要未覆盖更大规模或更多类型的环化化学。
items.abstract_zh: 受限大环肽可以结合同时抵抗小分子和生物制剂的蛋白表面，但在文库规模上制备它们仍依赖缓慢、专业化且难以并行的化学合成和大环化流程。我们描述了一种适用于96孔板的二硫键稳定环肽重组流程，从而降低这一门槛。肽编码序列通过延伸PCR和体内组装（IVA）克隆导入，以小泛素样修饰蛋白（SUMO）融合物形式表达，并分泌到氧化性周质中，在那里分子内二硫键自发形成；随后通过固定化金属亲和层析（IMAC）和分析型体积排阻色谱（SEC）进行纯化。从设计清单到获得表征材料的流程约需一周，其中大部分步骤无需人工值守。在覆盖9个蛋白靶标的60个设计文库上应用该流程后，60个设计均获得了纯化产物；每6 mL培养物的总可溶性产率中位数约为135微克，范围为9至261微克，并随靶标而变化。对38个设计进行Ellman检测表明，二硫键形成失败由序列驱动且与产率不相关，发现了色谱无法观察到的失败模式。表面等离子体共振证实了靶标结合，并显示重组SUMO融合构建体保持了与相应纯肽形式相当的亲和力。该流程可作为通用重组平台的补充，实现更高通量的二硫键大环筛选，并适用于部分或完全自动化的工作流。
items.author_line: Flores Bueso, Y., Gokce-Alpkilic, G., Jeung, J., Rettie, S., Li, X., Tangney, M., Baker, D., Bhardwaj, G.

items.title: Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches. Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. We systematically evaluate more than 20 representative approaches under consistent experimental conditions and across multiple datasets and partitioning strategies, enabling a fair and reproducible comparison of model performance. In addition, we complement this empirical study with a structured literature analysis to contextualize existing methodological trends and performance claims. Our results provide a clearer and more reliable assessment of the current state of the field, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of existing graph-based approaches. To support transparency and reproducibility, we release our benchmarking framework as open-source software https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox, allowing the community to evaluate and compare models under consistent conditions.
items.summary_zh: 研究在统一数据、预处理和评估条件下，系统比较20多种图深度学习毒性预测方法，并跨多个数据集和划分策略分析其性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为药物毒性预测提供可复现的公平比较框架，并公开BenchTox软件；但基准结果仍受数据集代表性、划分方案和体外到体内外推限制影响。
items.abstract_zh: 药物发现成本高且风险大，毒性相关失败仍是临床前和临床阶段项目流失的主要原因。因此，准确地早期预测化学毒性对于降低后续成本和改进化合物优先级排序至关重要。在这一背景下，图深度学习（GDL）已成为毒性预测的重要范式，它利用分子图表示直接从化学结构中学习，相比传统方法具有更强的表达能力。尽管提出的模型越来越多，但由于数据集、预处理流程和评估方案不一致，基于文献的比较往往难以解释。为解决这一限制，我们建立了一个统一、标准化的GDL毒性预测基准框架。在一致的实验条件下，并跨多个数据集和划分策略，我们系统评估了20多种具有代表性的方法，从而实现公平且可复现的模型性能比较。此外，我们还通过结构化文献分析对实证研究进行补充，以说明现有方法趋势和性能声明的背景。我们的结果更清晰、更可靠地评估了该领域当前状态，揭示了现有图模型方法的优势和局限。为支持透明性和可复现性，我们发布了开源基准框架https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox，使研究群体能够在一致条件下评估和比较模型。
items.author_line: Noel Suarez-Barro, Manuel Lama, Juan C. Vidal

items.title: Language-model-derived training data for polymer glass transition prediction: a controlled benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Experimental glass transition temperatures (Tg) are known for only a few thousand polymers, and each new one costs a synthesis and a measurement. Large language models (LLMs) have read much of the polymer literature and answer questions about polymers for a fraction of a cent. We tested whether such answers can replace or supplement measurements for Tg prediction by two routes: asking Claude Sonnet 5 to write polymers together with their Tg, and asking it to assign a Tg to existing hypothetical polymers. Both datasets were used to train a chemical language model, which was compared on held-out measurements with the same model trained on a growing number of real measurements, alone or after a first stage on the synthetic data. Controls with shuffled Tg values and with the model’s own pseudo-labels separated the value of the LLM’s labels from that of merely seeing more structures. Models trained only on LLM data were about as accurate as the LLM itself and clearly worse than models trained on real data. The LLM data helped only when a few hundred measurements were available, and the benefit disappeared when the Tg values were shuffled. Many “generated” polymers were recalled copies of known polymers, and the LLM’s Tg values were coarse and biased low. LLM-produced data are thus an inexpensive supplement when measurements are scarce, not a substitute for them.
items.summary_zh: 该受控基准检验由Claude Sonnet 5生成的聚合物及玻璃化转变温度标签能否用于Tg预测，并与真实测量数据训练的模型进行比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 通过打乱标签和伪标签对照区分了结构数量效应与LLM标签价值，结论清楚地限定了合成数据只能在测量样本很少时作为补充；生成聚合物存在已知结构复现和Tg偏低偏粗的问题。
items.abstract_zh: 实验测得的玻璃化转变温度（Tg）仅对几千种聚合物已知，而每一种新的聚合物都需要合成和测量。大型语言模型（LLM）读过大量聚合物文献，并可以用不到一美分的成本回答关于聚合物的问题。我们通过两种方式测试这些回答能否替代或补充Tg测量：要求Claude Sonnet 5同时写出聚合物及其Tg，以及要求其为现有的假想聚合物指定Tg。我们利用这两套数据训练化学语言模型，并在留出的测量数据上进行比较；对照模型使用不断增加的真实测量数据训练，或先在合成数据上进行第一阶段训练再使用真实数据训练。通过打乱Tg值以及使用模型自身伪标签的对照实验，我们区分了LLM标签本身的价值与仅仅观察更多结构所带来的价值。仅使用LLM数据训练的模型，其准确性约等于LLM本身，明显低于使用真实数据训练的模型。只有在已有几百个测量值时，LLM数据才有所帮助；当Tg值被打乱后，这一收益消失。许多“生成”的聚合物是已知聚合物的回忆式复制，而LLM给出的Tg数值粗糙且存在偏低偏差。因此，在测量数据稀缺时，LLM生成的数据可以作为低成本补充，但不能替代测量。

items.title: Simultaneous CEA and CDH-17 Detection from Cancer Extracellular Vesicles Via Machine Learning Enabled Bio Silent Azide-Infrared Spectroscopy
items.abstract_or_text: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) provide a rich, minimally invasive source of cancer biomarkers, yet EV surface glycoproteins remain comparatively underexploited compared with EV internal cargo. Here, we report a bio silent, azide-based Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopic platform for simultaneous, label-minimal detection of two colorectal cancer (CRC) EV surface biomarkers, carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and cadherin-17 (CDH-17), directly from intact vesicles. EVs from five CRC cell lines and a non-cancerous control line were first distinguished by their intrinsic biochemical fingerprints across the lipid, protein, carbohydrate, and nucleic acid spectral regions, achieving up to 97% classification accuracy by multivariate (PCA/SIMCA) and machine-learning (PLS-DA) analysis. Selective azide labeling of CEA and CDH-17 via biotinylated antibodies and streptavidin–azide generated a specific vibrational signal in the 2000–2300 cm⁻¹ bio-silent window without perturbing native EV spectra; peak authenticity was confirmed by Gaussian deconvolution, quantitative signal-to-noise analysis (SNR = 315 ± 99), and buffer/serum-artifact controls. Density-of-states overlap, cosine correlation, and constrained non-negative least-squares regression enabled simultaneous deconvolution and quantification of both biomarkers from mixed-antibody spectra, resolving cell line–specific expression patterns and enabling EV subtyping. Critically, the platform was validated on plasma-derived EVs from CRC patients and a healthy donor, where diagnostic performance exceeded that of the cell-line panel (AUC = 1.0 for metastatic CRC vs. healthy across all six spectral ratios; AUC = 0.58–1.0 for early-stage CRC vs. healthy). These results establish azide-FTIR spectroscopy as a rapid, label-efficient, and artifact-controlled platform for multiplexed EV biomarker detection, with direct evidence of its translatability to clinical liquid biopsy specimens rather than relying on cell-line data alone.
items.summary_zh: 研究构建了基于生物静默叠氮红外光谱和机器学习的外泌体检测平台，可同时定量CEA和CDH-17，并在结直肠癌患者血浆外泌体上进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 从细胞系扩展到临床血浆样本，并结合峰分解、信噪比和血清伪影对照证明检测特异性；早期结直肠癌样本的AUC范围较宽，临床泛化仍需更大队列。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞外囊泡（EV）是丰富且微创的癌症生物标志物来源，但与EV内部货物相比，EV表面糖蛋白的利用仍相对不足。在此，我们报告一种基于生物静默叠氮基的傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱平台，用于直接从完整囊泡中同时、低标记地检测两种结直肠癌（CRC）EV表面生物标志物：癌胚抗原（CEA）和钙黏蛋白-17（CDH-17）。首先，利用脂质、蛋白质、碳水化合物和核酸光谱区域的内在生化指纹，通过多变量分析（PCA/SIMCA）和机器学习（PLS-DA）将来自5种CRC细胞系和1种非癌对照细胞系的EV区分开来，分类准确率最高达到97%。通过生物素化抗体和链霉亲和素-叠氮基对CEA和CDH-17进行选择性叠氮标记，在2000–2300 cm⁻¹生物静默窗口产生特异性振动信号，同时不扰动EV的天然光谱；通过高斯去卷积、定量信噪比分析（SNR = 315 ± 99）以及缓冲液/血清伪影对照确认峰的真实性。态密度重叠、余弦相关和约束非负最小二乘回归实现了从混合抗体光谱中同时对两种生物标志物进行解卷积和定量，解析了细胞系特异的表达模式，并实现EV分型。关键的是，在来源于CRC患者和一名健康供体的血浆EV上验证该平台时，其诊断性能超过了细胞系面板：在所有六种光谱比值上，转移性CRC与健康对照的AUC均为1.0；早期CRC与健康对照的AUC为0.58–1.0。这些结果表明，叠氮-FTIR光谱是一种快速、低标记且经过伪影控制的多重EV生物标志物检测平台，并直接证明其可转化到临床液体活检样本，而不只是依赖细胞系数据。
items.author_line: Debashish Paul, Natasha Natasha, Sunita Saha, Suchetan Pal, Ananya Ananya, Saroj Kumar, Chrysafis Andreou, Tatini Rakshit

items.title: Small-Molecule Data Splitting for Machine Learning in Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Data splitting is a critical determinant of machine-learning performance in small-molecule drug design. Different strategies impose distinct assumptions about structural similarity, temporal order, data provenance and chemical-space coverage, thereby affecting both evaluation realism and the interpretation of model performance. This perspective critically examines major splitting approaches, discusses their advantages, applicability and limitations, and offers evidence-based considerations for designing partitions aligned with intended prediction scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 该综述系统讨论小分子药物设计中随机、结构、时间、来源和化学空间划分策略对机器学习评估真实性及性能解释的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 指出数据划分会改变模型性能和结论含义，并给出与目标预测场景匹配的证据化建议；作为观点文章，它不提供新的模型或独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 数据划分是小分子药物设计中机器学习性能的关键决定因素。不同策略对结构相似性、时间顺序、数据来源和化学空间覆盖施加了不同假设，从而影响评估的真实性以及对模型性能的解释。本文综述批判性地考察主要划分方法，讨论其优点、适用性和局限，并为设计与预期预测场景相匹配的数据分区提出基于证据的考量。
items.author_line: Cao-Minh Truong, Van-Thinh To, Gia-Bao Truong, Alexey Orlov, Pedro J. Ballester, Olivier Taboureau, Viet-Khoa Tran-Nguyen

items.title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.
items.summary_zh: MatToolBench在Windows 11虚拟机中评测多模态GUI代理操作材料科学专业软件的能力，覆盖10个工具、204项任务和GUI、OriginPro脚本、代码查询三种模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把材料科研软件中的隐性流程知识、跨工具交接和视觉状态纳入真实环境基准，显示通用基准成绩难以迁移；最佳模型在GUI任务上成功率仅25%，说明仍存在明显实用瓶颈。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态GUI代理在通用软件基准上已取得令人印象深刻的结果，但其操作专业科学软件的能力仍基本未被探索。在材料科学中，稀疏的领域专属网络数据、专门化界面和隐性的工作流惯例造成了通用预训练难以弥补的盲点。我们提出MatToolBench，这是首个在真实环境中评估多模态GUI代理操作材料科学专业软件的基准，包含在Windows 11虚拟机中执行的10个工具、204项任务，以及三种模式：GUI操作、OriginPro脚本和基于代码的数据库查询。每项任务都由领域专家分解为细粒度子标准，从而实现可解释的部分得分；我们的多层评估流程中，GUI组件达到0.98的平均F1。对于OriginPro图形生成任务，我们进一步开展人类-LLM一致性研究，以验证使用多模态评判器进行次级美学评价的可行性。实验表明，在通用基准上的强性能无法迁移到专业科学工作流，这一差距也不仅仅是视觉定位问题：失败源于领域特定的操作知识、科学软件预训练覆盖不足、跨工具产物交接薄弱，以及只有在视觉上暴露的关键状态。即使是最佳模型，在GUI任务上的成功率也只有25%，在代码任务上的成功率为45%。因此，MatToolBench可作为数据稀缺、知识密集型科学工作流的挑战性诊断基准和真实环境试验台。
items.author_line: Mei Wu, Rui Xie, Runyu Zhang, Yuqiang Li, Tianfan Fu, Bo Chen, Kai Yu, Xin Chen, Lu Chen

items.title: Advances in Multiscale Computational Modeling of 2D Nanomaterials for Solar Cells: From Interface Design to Fabrication and Stability
items.abstract_or_text: Two-dimensional (2D) nanomaterials provide a versatile platform for next-generation solar cells because their electronic structure, optical response, carrier transport, and interfacial chemistry can be engineered across multiple scales. However, photovoltaic performance and operational stability are governed not only by intrinsic material properties but also by coupled processes involving charge redistribution, interfacial recombination, ion migration, thermal transport, degradation, and fabrication-dependent microstructure. This review presents a closed-loop multiscale computational framework for the design, fabrication, and optimization of 2D-material-enabled solar cells. Density functional theory (DFT) and related quantum-mechanical methods are discussed for predicting band structure, band alignment, charge transfer, defect states, and optical properties, while molecular dynamics (MD) simulations address structural stability, ion migration, thermal effects, interfacial dynamics, and degradation. Finite element method (FEM)/COMSOL and device-scale models connect material-level descriptors to charge transport, recombination, thermal behavior, and photovoltaic metrics. Machine learning (ML) further enables high-throughput screening, property prediction, processing optimization, and inverse design. Particular emphasis is placed on bridging the simulation-to-fabrication gap by linking processing variables, including concentration, flake dimensions, functionalization, deposition, annealing, and interface formation, to realized structure and device performance. Experimental characterization and feedback are incorporated to refine computational models and guide subsequent design decisions. Overall, integrating quantum, atomistic, device-scale, data-driven, and fabrication-aware approaches provides a pathway toward efficient, stable, reproducible, and scalable 2D-material-based photovoltaic technologies.
items.summary_zh: 该综述提出面向二维纳米材料太阳能电池的闭环多尺度计算框架，将DFT、MD、FEM/COMSOL、机器学习、制备变量和实验反馈连接起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 强调从模拟到制备和器件稳定性的跨尺度闭环，适合指导高通量筛选、逆向设计及工艺优化；但文章为综述，具体模型性能和可重复实验结果取决于所引用研究。
items.abstract_zh: 二维（2D）纳米材料为下一代太阳能电池提供了多功能平台，因为其电子结构、光学响应、载流子输运和界面化学可以在多个尺度上进行工程化调控。然而，光伏性能和运行稳定性不仅由材料的内在性质决定，还受到电荷再分布、界面复合、离子迁移、热输运、降解以及制备相关微结构等耦合过程的影响。本综述提出一个用于2D材料太阳能电池设计、制备和优化的闭环多尺度计算框架。文中讨论了密度泛函理论（DFT）及相关量子力学方法，用于预测能带结构、能带对齐、电荷转移、缺陷态和光学性质；同时，分子动力学（MD）模拟用于研究结构稳定性、离子迁移、热效应、界面动力学和降解。有限元法（FEM）/COMSOL及器件尺度模型将材料尺度描述符与电荷输运、复合、热行为和光伏指标联系起来。机器学习（ML）进一步支持高通量筛选、性质预测、加工优化和逆向设计。文章特别强调弥合模拟与制备之间的差距，即将浓度、片层尺寸、功能化、沉积、退火和界面形成等工艺变量与实际形成的结构和器件性能联系起来。文中纳入实验表征和反馈，用于改进计算模型并指导后续设计决策。总体而言，整合量子尺度、原子尺度、器件尺度、数据驱动以及面向制备的多种方法，为实现高效、稳定、可重复且可规模化的二维材料光伏技术提供了一条路径。

items.title: From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Existing protein geometry models typically represent molecular surfaces using local geometric features such as sampled points, normals, and curvature. While effective for capturing exposed molecular shape, these representations do not explicitly model the volumetric organization beneath the surface or provide a consistent coordinate system for residue-wise volumetric structure. We introduce Protein-TetSphere, a registered residue-wise volumetric representation for proteins. Each protein chain is tetrahedralized to obtain local volumetric regions associated with individual residues, which are then registered to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference and represented in a common Laplacian basis. This registration establishes consistent volumetric coordinates across residues, enabling local three-dimensional deformation to be integrated with surface and chemical information in a multimodal protein representation. We evaluate Protein-TetSphere on ligand-binding pocket classification, protein--protein interface prediction, and de novo protein binder design. Across the three tasks, Protein-TetSphere improves ligand-binding pocket balanced accuracy from 0.795 to 0.826, Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC from 0.914/0.852 to 0.932/0.866, and binder-design success from 14.95\% to 19.90\% on the BoltzGen Challenge Set and from 27.62\% to 32.19\% at the ProtDBench backbone level. These results show that registered volumetric geometry provides complementary spatial information beyond molecular surfaces across protein recognition, interaction, and design.
items.summary_zh: Protein-TetSphere将蛋白质链四面体化，并注册到固定拓扑参考和共同拉普拉斯基底，建立残基级体积几何表示，用于结合口袋分类、蛋白界面预测和从头结合蛋白设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 补充传统分子表面表示缺失的内部体积和统一坐标信息，在三个任务上均有定量提升；但摘要未说明改进是否跨数据集和蛋白家族稳定保持。
items.abstract_zh: 现有蛋白质几何模型通常使用采样点、法向量和曲率等局部几何特征来表示分子表面。虽然这些表示能够有效捕捉暴露的分子形状，但它们没有显式建模表面下方的体积组织，也没有为逐残基体积结构提供一致的坐标系。我们提出Protein-TetSphere，一种注册的逐残基蛋白质体积表示。我们对每条蛋白质链进行四面体化，以获得与各个残基相关联的局部体积区域；随后将这些区域注册到共享的固定拓扑四面体参考，并在共同的拉普拉斯基底中表示。该注册建立了一致的体积坐标，使局部三维形变能够与表面和化学信息整合到多模态蛋白质表示中。我们在配体结合口袋分类、蛋白质-蛋白质界面预测和从头蛋白质结合剂设计三个任务上评估Protein-TetSphere。在这三个任务中，Protein-TetSphere将配体结合口袋平衡准确率从0.795提高到0.826，将Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC从0.914/0.852提高到0.932/0.866，并将结合剂设计成功率在BoltzGen Challenge Set上从14.95%提高到19.90%，在ProtDBench骨架层面从27.62%提高到32.19%。这些结果表明，注册的体积几何能够在蛋白质识别、相互作用和设计中提供超越分子表面的互补空间信息。
items.author_line: Siyuan Chen, Cai Zhou, Jinrui Zhang, Zhaokang Liang, Taku Komura, Wojciech Matusik, Stephen Bates, Tommi Jaakkola, Wengong Jin, Peter Yichen Chen, Minghao Guo

items.title: Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States for Molecular Potential Energy Surfaces in Second Quantization
items.abstract_or_text: Second-quantized neural-network quantum states have achieved accurate molecular energies, but extending them across molecular geometries requires a shared representation of the geometry-dependent wavefunction coefficients. We introduce geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum states for molecular electronic structure in second quantization. A single autoregressive model learns a family of ground states from sparse anchor geometries and provides wavefunctions at untrained geometries without further optimization. Orbital alignment matches orbital identities and transports their phases, establishing an aligned orbital basis across geometries. Frozen energies reach chemical accuracy at every untrained query geometry for N_2, CO, and H_4. On additional molecular paths, the energy-trained wavefunctions yield dipoles, quadrupoles, and natural occupations without property labels. Across three paired N_2 training seeds, orbital alignment lowers the mean absolute energy error over all untrained query geometries from 34-37 mHa to 0.049-0.085 mHa. At approximately 1 mHa mean absolute error, frozen evaluation reduces the per-geometry cost by 986\times relative to independent optimization, yielding an estimated 25.8\times end-to-end GPU-cost reduction on a 161-point N_2 grid.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出几何条件化的二次量子化神经网络量子态，用单个自回归模型从稀疏锚点几何学习一族基态，并在未训练几何上无需再优化地给出波函数和能量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 轨道对齐使未训练几何上的能量误差降至0.049–0.085 mHa，并将冻结评估的单几何成本降低986倍；当前展示主要集中于N₂、CO和H₄等小体系。
items.abstract_zh: 二次量子化神经网络量子态已经能够准确计算分子能量，但要将其扩展到不同分子几何，需要对依赖几何的波函数系数建立共享表示。我们提出用于二次量子化分子电子结构的几何条件化基础神经网络量子态。单个自回归模型从稀疏的锚点几何中学习一族基态，并能够在未训练的几何上无需进一步优化地提供波函数。轨道对齐匹配轨道身份并传递其相位，从而在不同几何之间建立对齐的轨道基组。在N₂、CO和H₄上，冻结能量在每个未训练查询几何处都达到化学精度。在额外的分子路径上，经过能量训练的波函数无需性质标签便能给出偶极矩、四极矩和自然占据数。在三组配对的N₂训练随机种子中，轨道对齐将所有未训练查询几何上的平均绝对能量误差从34–37 mHa降至0.049–0.085 mHa。在约1 mHa平均绝对误差下，与独立优化相比，冻结评估将每个几何的成本降低986倍，并在161点N₂网格上估计实现端到端GPU成本降低25.8倍。
items.author_line: Lizhong Fu, Jianan Wei, Wenguan Wang, Honghui Shang

items.title: Unified modeling of mutation-induced protein stability responses with OmegaTherm
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate prediction of mutation-induced protein stability responses, including changes in folding free energy and melting temperature, is critical for protein engineering. Existing models represent these related but non-equivalent measurements separately and often focus on single mutations. Here we present OmegaTherm, a sequence-based framework that jointly learns both stability responses for single and multiple mutations. OmegaTherm introduces a shared protein language model to capture transferable mutation context, measurement-specific encoders to preserve measurement identity, and paired-measurement-informed distillation to learn complementary knowledge from heterogeneous data. An antisymmetric prediction architecture further enforces physical consistency between forward and reverse mutations. Across independent benchmarks, OmegaTherm achieves state-of-the-art performance in quantitative prediction, mutation classification and protein-level ranking. Beyond benchmark prediction, OmegaTherm-derived stability landscapes correlate strongly with fitness landscapes from deep mutational scanning, enrich favorable variants and reveal function-associated mutation-sensitive regions. These results establish unified representation learning as an effective strategy for integrating related but non-equivalent biochemical measurements.
items.summary_zh: OmegaTherm以共享蛋白语言模型、测量特异编码器、配对测量蒸馏和反对称预测结构，联合预测单突变和多突变引起的折叠自由能与熔解温度变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在独立基准、定量预测、突变分类和蛋白排序上报告最先进表现，并与深度突变扫描适应度景观相关；但摘要未给出各数据集规模和具体误差。
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测突变引起的蛋白质稳定性响应，包括折叠自由能和熔解温度的变化，对于蛋白质工程至关重要。现有模型通常分别表示这些相关但不等价的测量，并且往往聚焦于单突变。在此，我们提出OmegaTherm，一种基于序列的框架，联合学习单突变和多突变的两类稳定性响应。OmegaTherm引入共享蛋白语言模型以捕捉可迁移的突变上下文，引入测量特异的编码器以保留测量身份，并利用配对测量信息蒸馏，从异质数据中学习互补知识。反对称预测结构进一步对正向和反向突变施加物理一致性约束。在独立基准上，OmegaTherm在定量预测、突变分类和蛋白质层面排序方面均取得最先进性能。除基准预测之外，OmegaTherm导出的稳定性景观与深度突变扫描得到的适应度景观高度相关，能够富集有利变体，并揭示与功能相关的突变敏感区域。这些结果表明，统一表征学习是整合相关但不等价生化测量的一种有效策略。
items.author_line: Wang, W., Zhou, Y., Yu, W., Wu, Y., Yang, Q., Zheng, R., Huang, X., Li, M., Zhang, Y.

items.title: Curvature-Aware Flow Matching for Molecular Structure Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Generative models produce three-dimensional molecular structures with high geometric accuracy, yet they are trained on distributions of atomic coordinates without explicit access to the underlying physics. The potential energy surface (PES) describes how the energy changes around a molecular geometry, and the RMSD between a generated structure and its reference captures this local landscape only indirectly. Supervising the PES during training could close this gap, but conformers and transition states (TSs) are stationary points at which the forces vanish, so first-order quantities carry little information about them. What remains is the local curvature, encoded in the Hessian of the PES. Quantum-chemical Hessians are too expensive to be available at the scale required for training, but recently proposed machine-learned predictors make curvature inexpensive enough to supervise directly. We introduce CurvFM, a flow matching (FM) formulation whose training objective constrains the curvature at the generated structure. A frozen Hessian prediction model is evaluated at the generated endpoint and at the reference structure, which removes the need for quantum-chemical Hessians and keeps the residual cheap enough to impose at every training step. Across TS and conformer generation, CurvFM substantially improves physical fidelity at unchanged global structural accuracy, reducing the median deviation in maximum force by 63% on GEOM-QM9 and raising the fraction of valid TSs by up to 10% across three reaction datasets.
items.summary_zh: CurvFM在流匹配训练中加入由机器学习Hessian预测器提供的势能面曲率约束，在保持整体结构精度不变的同时改善构象和过渡态生成的物理保真度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在GEOM-QM9上将最大力中位偏差降低63%，并在三个反应数据集上将有效过渡态比例最多提高10%；依赖冻结的机器学习Hessian预测器，量子化学Hessian本身未用于逐步训练。
items.abstract_zh: 生成模型能够以很高的几何精度产生三维分子结构，但其训练基于原子坐标分布，并未显式获得底层物理信息。势能面（PES）描述分子几何附近能量如何变化，而生成结构与参考结构之间的RMSD只能间接反映这一局部景观。在训练中对PES进行监督可能弥合这一差距，但构象和过渡态（TS）是力为零的驻点，因此一阶量对它们包含的信息很少。剩下的信息是由PES的Hessian编码的局部曲率。量子化学Hessian成本过高，无法以训练所需的规模获得，但近期提出的机器学习预测器使曲率足够廉价，可以直接用于监督。我们提出CurvFM，一种流匹配（FM）形式，其训练目标约束生成结构处的曲率。在生成端点和参考结构处分别使用冻结的Hessian预测模型，从而无需量子化学Hessian，并使残差足够低廉，可以在每个训练步骤中施加。在过渡态和构象生成任务中，CurvFM在保持整体结构精度不变的同时显著提高物理保真度：在GEOM-QM9上将最大力的中位偏差降低63%，并在三个反应数据集上将有效过渡态比例最多提高10%。
items.author_line: Samir Darouich, Juliane Geisler, Jacob W. Toney, Tanja Bien, Johannes Kästner, Heather J. Kulik, Mathias Niepert

items.title: StateFlux: DFT-Validated Quantum Reactivity across Predicted Metabolic State Networks Shows Limited Incremental Value for Broad Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly used to supplement parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity, but added physical detail does not necessarily provide predictive information beyond structure. StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 positive and 220 negative), 10 × 5 scaffold-grouped validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests showed no consistent gain, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity transfer benchmark reproduced the pattern (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore). To separate limited predictive utility from inaccurate low-cost quantum chemistry, 24 parent-to-metabolite transformations were evaluated with 144 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD single-point calculations. GFN2-xTB closely tracked DFT changes in electrophilicity (Pearson r = 0.963; MAE = 0.408 eV; 79.2% sign agreement). Thus, transformation-induced quantum reactivity can be consistent with higher-level DFT without providing reliable incremental information for broad toxicity classification. Quantum-chemical fidelity and predictive utility should therefore be evaluated as separate claims in chemical machine learning.
items.summary_zh: StateFlux把药物及其预测代谢状态表示成化学状态网络，并用GFN2-xTB反应性特征和DFT对照检验其对DILI及遗传毒性预测的增量价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 严格的时间和骨架新颖性测试显示，加入量子反应性并未稳定改善广义毒性分类，同时以144次DFT单点计算验证了低成本量子化学的一致性，清楚区分了物理保真度与预测效用。
items.abstract_zh: 机制性分子表示正越来越多地用于在母体结构之外补充质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性，但增加物理细节并不一定能提供超越结构本身的预测信息。StateFlux将每种药物表示为由化学状态和预测代谢状态组成的网络，节点包含GFN2-xTB性质，边则记录电离势、电子亲和能、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性的变化。在锁定的DILIrank 2.0开发集（n = 376；156个阳性和220个阴性）上，10 × 5次按骨架分组的验证得到：ECFP的AUROC/AUPRC为0.8249/0.7727，ECFP + FluxCore为0.8049/0.7430，ECFP + StateFluxCore为0.8010/0.7261。严格的时间外推和新骨架测试没有显示一致的增益；在独立的5,367种化合物遗传毒性迁移基准上也复现了这一模式（ECFP的AUROC为0.7765，StateFluxCore为0.7732）。为区分有限的预测效用与低成本量子化学的不准确性，我们使用144次ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD单点计算评估了24个母体到代谢物的转化。GFN2-xTB能够紧密追踪DFT得到的亲电性变化（Pearson r = 0.963；MAE = 0.408 eV；符号一致率79.2%）。因此，转化诱导的量子反应性可以与更高水平的DFT保持一致，却不能为广义毒性分类提供可靠的增量信息。在化学机器学习中，应将量子化学保真度和预测效用作为彼此独立的主张进行评估。

items.title: Bridging the gap between omics and structural data: A framework for interpreting protein-RNA interaction specificity
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-RNA interactions play a central role in many cellular processes, such as gene regulation, protein synthesis and viral infections. Although a few thousand protein-RNA complexes have been structurally characterized, they represent only a small fraction of all interactions. This lack of experimental data limits the ability of deep-learning based approaches such as AlphaFold3 to predict structures of protein-RNA interactions. In this study, we investigate protein-RNA binding specificity by enriching experimental structures with omics data. To this end, we present a scoring approach and associated web resource quantifying the agreement between experimental structures of protein-RNA interfaces and their omics-derived binding preferences, allowing us to identify interaction motif cores. Through key structural and evolutionary features, we further highlight that these motif cores correspond to important interface regions. We then leverage the dataset of protein-RNA complexes for which structural information can be combined with binding preferences in order to benchmark the ability of AlphaFold3 to predict protein-RNA interaction specificity. To this aim, we run AlphaFold3 predictions using different RNA inputs, from the exact sequence present in the experimental structure to a non-specific sequence, including sequences embedding the consensus binding motif from in vitro experiments. We show that despite good prediction quality, the sensitivity of AlphaFold3 to the exact RNA sequence used as input indicates signs of memorization. We examine some particular complexes and uncover challenges encountered by our scoring workflow and AlphaFold3, especially in the case of alternative binding modes. Altogether, this work evidences both the promise and current limitations of deep learning approaches for protein-RNA structure prediction, and provides a resource to guide their further development.
items.summary_zh: 研究将实验蛋白质-RNA复合物结构与组学结合偏好整合，建立界面基序核心评分和网络资源，并测试AlphaFold3对RNA序列特异性的预测能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把有限结构数据与组学偏好结合起来，并揭示AlphaFold3对输入RNA精确序列的敏感性可能包含记忆化；替代结合模式仍会给评分流程和结构预测带来困难。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-RNA相互作用在基因调控、蛋白质合成和病毒感染等许多细胞过程中发挥核心作用。尽管已有几千个蛋白质-RNA复合物得到结构表征，但它们只占全部相互作用的一小部分。实验数据的缺乏限制了AlphaFold3等基于深度学习的方法预测蛋白质-RNA相互作用结构的能力。在本研究中，我们通过用组学数据丰富实验结构，研究蛋白质-RNA结合特异性。为此，我们提出一种评分方法及其配套的网络资源，用于量化蛋白质-RNA界面的实验结构与组学推导的结合偏好之间的一致性，从而识别相互作用基序核心。通过关键的结构和进化特征，我们进一步指出这些基序核心对应重要的界面区域。随后，我们利用能够将结构信息与结合偏好结合起来的蛋白质-RNA复合物数据集，基准评估AlphaFold3预测蛋白质-RNA相互作用特异性的能力。具体而言，我们使用不同的RNA输入运行AlphaFold3预测，输入范围从实验结构中实际存在的精确序列到非特异序列，其中还包括嵌入体外实验共识结合基序的序列。我们显示，尽管预测质量良好，但AlphaFold3对所用精确RNA输入序列的敏感性表明存在记忆化迹象。我们考察了若干复合物，并发现该评分流程和AlphaFold3面临的挑战，尤其是在存在替代结合模式的情况下。总的来说，这项工作说明了深度学习方法在蛋白质-RNA结构预测中的前景和当前局限，并提供了可指导其进一步发展的资源。
items.author_line: Fauconnet, Y., Deng, S., Koundri, R., Pagani, M., Quignot, C., Antonio, D., Andreani, J.
